_comment: IC-shrunk ensemble weights estimated by pit_ic_backtest.py Phase-1 pilot (FY2021-FY2024, 12-month forward returns). lambda_shrink=0.40 applied toward equal weight over the 2 positive-IC models. Models with negative/zero IC are floored to 0 and kept as diagnostics only. Re-estimate by re-running pit_ic_backtest with --phase2. Do NOT hand-tune these weights.
